changes.old: Medium close shot beside a small wooden relief cottage in a 1907 American camp, one tall grey-haired middle-aged resident with sideburns in a plain dark wool coat places one hand on the cottage's simple plank doorway, its low roof and timber wall filling the background, bare earth at his feet, overcast daylight
changes.new: Medium close shot of one elderly grey-haired resident with a deeply lined face and dark high-collared wool coat at the open doorway of a small low wooden relief cottage in a 1907 camp; one hand rests on the plain broad-plank door, the low roof edge just above him, empty pale sky behind, soft overcast light

changes.old: Close shot inside a small 1907 wooden relief cottage, one adult resident's weathered hands in plain wool sleeves place a closed cloth coin purse on a completely blank paper sheet on a rough wooden table, bare timber wall behind, soft window daylight
changes.new: Medium close shot inside a plain wooden relief cottage in 1907, one elderly woman with silver hair, a lined face and a dark high-collared dress places a small tied cloth pouch beside a single completely blank paper sheet on a bare wooden table, simple plank wall behind, soft window daylight

changes.old: Close shot on a rough wooden desk inside a plain 1907 relief office, one adult clerk's weathered hands in dark wool sleeves hold two completely blank paper slips apart above a closed cloth coin purse, bare plaster wall beyond, soft window daylight
changes.new: Medium close shot inside a bare 1907 relief office, one elderly clerk with grey hair, a deeply lined face and dark high-collared waistcoat turns one completely blank folded paper in his hands above a bare wooden desk, a small tied cloth pouch beside it, plain plaster wall and tall-window daylight

changes.old: Close shot at the low wooden doorstep of a 1907 relief cottage, a closed cloth coin purse lies on bare ground while one weathered adult hand in a dark wool sleeve hovers beside it, the cottage's plank door fills the background, soft overcast daylight
changes.new: Medium close shot beside a small wooden relief cottage in a 1907 camp, one elderly grey-haired observer with a deeply lined face in a dark high-collared wool coat looks down at a small tied cloth pouch resting on the rough wooden doorstep, the cottage plank doorway fills the background, soft overcast daylight
